Data on Japan's national geography and tools for processing and visualizing Japan's coordinate systems. Archived from CRAN in 2021; the source remains on [GitHub](https://github.com/uribo/kuniezu); documentation at [uribo.github.io/kuniezu](https://uribo.github.io/kuniezu/).
